summary: Frontend E2E testing of new Travel Packages vertical (Vol+Hôtel forfaits, iter292). Full user flow on /forfaits (list → book → done → mine → cancel) AND admin flow on /admin/travel-packages (Forfaits + Réservations tabs) fully validated. Critical propagation rule verified: a package booking creates underlying flight + hotel bookings (linked via package_booking_id) that show up in /vols 'Mes vols' and /hotels 'Mes séjours'; cancelling the package cascades to both underlying bookings and refunds the discounted total in one wallet transaction.
critical_code_review_comments: TravelPackagesPage.js – `validPax` is read inside useEffect deps via `passengers`, which is fine, but the eslint-disable comment hides that `validPax`'s `length` is the actual signal. Consider depending on `validPax.length` explicitly or memoising.
TravelPackagesPage.js – uses native `window.confirm` for cancellation; other verticals (hotels/flights) already do too, so consistent, but consider a shared in-app modal for mobile UX.

TravelPackagesPage.js – when `quote.available === false`, the CTA is correctly disabled, but the card list does not surface availability ahead of opening pkg-book; user only finds out on the booking screen. Consider an 'Indisponible' badge on pkg-card-{id} when packageOptions report unavailability.

AdminTravelPackages.js – PackagesTab uses index-based `Field` children without unique keys for option lists where `f.id` is empty (currently never empty in seed but defensive); also discount input does not clamp on blur (UI accepts >90 then server may reject).

AdminTravelPackages.js – when admin changes pkg-form-hotel, pkg-form-room is reset to '' correctly, but if a previously selected room belongs to the new hotel by id collision (rare) the user could re-select; minor.

Test-id naming inconsistency: spec mentions `admin-packages-tab` and `admin-package-bookings-tab` as the tab buttons, but code uses these as the panel containers and the tab buttons are `pkg-admin-tab-packages` / `pkg-admin-tab-bookings`. Both sets work, but main agent may want to align with spec naming for downstream automation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Travel Packages vertical (iter292) fully working end-to-end (user + admin + grouped cancellation + cascade to /vols + /hotels). Backend pytest 5/5 (test_iter292_travel_packages.py). Wallet credit endpoint is /api/admin/users/{user_id}/wallet/credit. The seeded demo forfait 'Escapade Paris — Hôtel La Pagerie' (pkg_ed2681cffe) is still available. The dev-server console emits a hydration warning about `<span>` inside `<option>` — this comes from the visual-editor instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic spans injected for hot reload), NOT real product code, and disappears in production build. Safe to ignore.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature is production-ready.
